title: 공원 안내도 읽기: 어디에 있어요? 몇 시까지 들어가요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean park map, ticket, and coupon to find where a place is, when you can get in, and when and how you can use a ticket or coupon.
summary: Learners read a Korean park map board, entrance ticket, and discount coupon to find places, opening times, and usage rules.
note: The park, prices, and coupon on this sheet are made-up examples, but they follow the layout of real Korean park signs.

task.title: Find the park information
task.line: Read each short sign, ticket, or coupon, then answer, choose, or fill in the blank.

sections.heading: Read the real material: 하늘숲공원 안내도
paragraphs: 정문 → 매표소 (오른쪽 30m) → 분수 광장 (도보 5분) → 장미 정원 (도보 10분) → 전망대 (도보 20분)
화장실·수유실: 안내소 1층  |  자전거 대여소: 후문 옆
운영 시간 09:00~18:00 (입장 마감 17:00)  |  매주 월요일 휴원
[입장권]  어른 3,000원 / 어린이 1,500원  |  당일 1회 입장  |  재입장 불가
[할인 쿠폰]  매점 음료 500원 할인  |  입장권을 보여 주세요  |  유효 기간: 2026. 12. 31.까지  |  다른 쿠폰과 함께 사용 불가

sections.heading: Key words on maps, tickets, and coupons

items.text: The star on the map shows where you are standing now.
You can ask questions or get a paper map here.
A room for feeding a baby or changing diapers.
You can borrow things like bikes or strollers here.
It shows how long it takes to walk there.
After this time, you cannot go in, even if the park is still open.
Going out and coming back in with the same ticket.
The park does not open on this day.
You can use the ticket or coupon only until this date.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Look for small words next to numbers: '~까지' (after a number or date) means 'until (and including)', and '도보' (before a time, as in 도보 5분) means 'on foot'. Times use the 24-hour clock, so 17:00 is 5 p.m.
'가능' means 'allowed' and '불가' means 'not allowed'. '평일' means weekdays (Monday to Friday), and '주말' means Saturday and Sunday. Always check these words before you use a ticket or coupon.

exercises: Find the information. Where is the toilet, and how far is it? Answer in Korean: ★ 현재 위치: 후문 | 화장실 → 왼쪽 50m | 주차장 → 오른쪽 100m
Yes or No. The coupon says '자전거 대여 30% 할인 | 평일에만 사용 가능'. Can you use it on these days? ① 수요일 ② 토요일
Yes or No. The ticket says '당일 재입장 가능 | 입장권을 보여 주세요'. You go out for lunch at noon. Can you come back in with this ticket?
Choose the right place: 아기에게 우유를 먹여야 해요. (수유실 / 매표소 / 전망대)에 가요.
Answer in Korean: 운영 시간 10:00~17:00 (입장 마감 16:30). 지금 16:40이에요. 공원에 들어갈 수 있어요?
Fill in the blank: 자전거를 타고 싶어요? 그럼 후문 옆 자전거 ____에서 빌리세요.
answers: Yes (show your ticket when you come back in)
